vari-dual-monitor-arm.spec_note: The spec table prints no per-monitor weight capacity row; the only capacity figure on the page is in the product description, which gives 8.98 kg per monitor. It is printed in kilograms and the page never converts it to pounds. The table's only weight figure is the 13.23lb product weight. The same table carries a column for the Monitor Arm + Laptop Stand, so the two arms can be compared on weight, but that column prints no capacity figure either.
vari-dual-monitor-arm.for_who: Vari's own description says the arms 'work seamlessly with all of our desks', are 'VESA compatible', hold 'up to 8.98 kg each' and 'can be rotated 360 degrees'. That is the seller's statement of what the arm fits, not an audience sentence: the page names no user type anywhere.
vari-dual-monitor-arm.judgment: Two monitors at 8.98 kg each is 17.96 kg, which is 39.59 lb at 2.20462 lb per kg (8.98 × 2.20462 = 19.80lb each) — the page prints the capacity in kilograms only and never does this conversion. The price move is $74.75 off $299.00, exactly 25.00% ($74.75 ÷ $299.00 = 0.2500). In the same spec table the laptop-stand column weighs 1.32lb more (14.55lb − 13.23lb = 1.32lb), so this arm is the lighter of the two by 9.98% of its own weight (1.32 ÷ 13.23 = 0.0998).

vari-monitor-arm-laptop-stand.spec_note: The table prints no weight capacity and no screen size limit for this arm; the five rows above are every number the page gives. The Monitor Capacity row reads 'Single with Cradle', which is the page's own way of saying the cradle takes one screen.
vari-monitor-arm-laptop-stand.for_who: Vari's description says the arm is for positioning 'your display and laptop side-by-side to use both screens together' — the laptop sits in the cradle, so the two screens are one monitor plus one laptop, not two monitors.
vari-monitor-arm-laptop-stand.judgment: One screen position costs $174.30 here. The dual arm's $224.25 covers two positions, which is $112.13 a position ($224.25 ÷ 2 = $112.125), so a second screen position costs about $62.18 less there ($174.30 − $112.125 = $62.175). The headline percentage points the other way: this arm is 30.00% off ($74.70 ÷ $249.00 = 0.3000) against 25.00% on the dual ($74.75 ÷ $299.00 = 0.2500), while the dollars saved differ by five cents ($74.75 − $74.70 = $0.05). The same $50.00 gap in reference price ($299.00 − $249.00 = $50.00) is what turns into a five-point gap in the percentage.
